{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_rows = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate conversion fraction
num_converted = loyal_rows['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(loyal_rows)
conversion_fraction = num_converted / num_total

# Print result
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {num_total}")
print(f"Number converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_fraction"}
